verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party GitLab webhook documentation. The only support is indirect partner-directory listings on about.gitlab.com: Make says it can "utilize webhooks, actions, and triggers" with GitLab, another partner mentions "continuous docs build using Webhook," and PagerDuty receives GitLab events such as merge requests. Together these imply GitLab emits outbound event callbacks, but only glancingly. Missing for 10: first-party docs on registering webhooks (project/group/system), the list of subscribable event types, payload schemas, secret/signature verification, delivery/retry behavior, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
